description: Routes one input to any one of eight outputs, picked by a button press or a gate rather than by stepping in order

params.text: Pressing this routes the input to the output of the same number, the change happening at the start of the press
Chooses what an output does once a different one is picked: S&H holds the value sampled when it was chosen, → drops to 0V, T&H holds the value it carried at the moment of the change

inputs.text: The signal routed to whichever output is currently picked
A rising edge above 2V routes the input to the output of the same number; the button for that output goes on working while a cable is patched here

outputs.text: Carries the input while that output is the one picked, and between selections behaves as the MODE switch sets
A 1ms trigger at 10V each time the selection changes; selections closer together than 1ms stretch the pulse rather than each firing their own

notes: one channel only; this module does not handle polyphonic signals
